The '''DeLuxFlux hyperdrive motivator''' was a power-intensive [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]] of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] manufacture. They were standard on [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]].
